metadata.description: Epistemic discipline for Claude Code: verification, reconnaissance-before-build, and a deterministic build gate. From the maker of brain-mcp.

plugins.name: prove-it
plugins.description: Verification discipline: every number carries its provenance in the same sentence; a test that cannot fail proves nothing; unknown is not healthy.

plugins.name: preflight
plugins.description: Reconnaissance before implementation: map everything that exists, produce a build spec, and STOP. Zero mutations until you say go.

plugins.name: build-gate
plugins.description: A PreToolUse hook that makes 'think first; build on the yes' deterministic: writes, deploys, and mutating SQL pause for one confirmation unless your last message carried a clear go.
